CustomObject.description: Core native RCA object that defines the selling motion for a product. SellingModelType options: OneTime, TermedSubscription, EvergreenSubscription. Every QuoteLineItem and OrderItem references a ProductSellingModel. This is what drives BillingSchedule frequency and Asset lifecycle dates. Replaces SBQQ__SubscriptionType__c and SBQQ__BillingFrequency__c from CPQ.
CustomObject.label: Product Selling Model
